create_copilot_acp_client: create a CopilotACPClient instance to use GitHub Copilot as an OpenAI-compatible chat backend
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion via CopilotACPClient.chat.completions.create with messages and optional tools
run_copilot_acp_session: run a Copilot ACP session by sending a formatted prompt and collecting streamed text chunks
extract_tool_calls_from_text: extract tool calls from Copilot response text using XML block or bare JSON patterns
format_messages_as_prompt: format a list of chat messages into a single prompt string with tool specs and transcript
